races.name: TRM Ironxcell For Energy Race
races.verdict:
LIKEDBYMIKE stands out on the figures and this is a good opportunity to gain just a second career success. Michael's Well could bounce back to something like his juvenile form here, with the long absent Bear On The Run an interesting unexposed contender.

  1. LIKEDBYMIKE (IRE)
  2. MICHAEL'S WELL (IRE)
  3. BEAR ON THE RUN (IRE)

races.name: Matchbook Betting Exchange Handicap
races.verdict:
GOTTA CATCH'EM ALL has shown improved form switched to sprinting with blinkers applied, making it back-to-back wins when scoring over C&D 12 days ago, and he can continue his progress to land the hat-trick. He gets the vote ahead of Amiata, who has won 2 of his last 3 starts, with Red Evolution also considered.

  1. GOTTA CATCH'EM ALL (IRE)
  2. AMIATA (IRE)
  3. RED EVOLUTION (IRE)

races.name: Matchbook Supporting Local Racing Apprentice Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
HOT TO FOXTROT wasted no time getting back to her best when staying on for third at Down Royal last month and, after only 3 starts over 5f, she can build on that effort to get off the mark. She is taken to reverse the form with Dandy Land from when the pair met 17 days ago, while Platino Bianco could also be in the mix.

  1. HOT TO FOXTROT (IRE)
  2. DANDY LAND (IRE)
  3. PLATINO BIANCO (IRE)

races.name: Bet 20 Get 40 With Matchbook Handicap
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for several of these but preference is for BEAR RIGHT, who remains a maiden but has been knocking at the door of late and Shane Foley is back in the saddle here. Sherekiya could well prove a different proposition now handicapping over a longer trip so she heads up the dangers, with Rappell and Land of The Giants another couple to consider, too.

  1. BEAR RIGHT (IRE)
  2. SHEREKIYA (IRE)
  3. RAPPELL (IRE)

races.name: Watch All Racing Live At Matchbook Handicap
races.verdict:
HAMIYAN finally gets the step up in trip he's long been crying out for and he can get the better of the in-form Daler. Letiza also shaped well on her yard debut last time and completes the shortlist in a good-looking race.

  1. HAMIYAN (FR)
  2. DALER (IRE)
  3. LETIZA (IRE)

races.name: Irish EBF Ballyhane Stakes (Median Sires Series)
races.verdict:
LIVENKA showed a good turn of foot when getting off the mark in a 6f Fairyhouse maiden and she can follow up at the chief expense of English raider Weekend Roar. Star Prospect can complete the 1-2-3.

  1. LIVENKA
  2. WEEKEND ROAR (IRE)
  3. STAR PROSPECT (IRE)

races.name: Hurling For Cancer On August 24th Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
A case of quantity over quality in this fillies maiden. NAUTIC STAR has shown enough to land a race of this nature and can finally open her account. The Joseph O'Brien pair Never The Same and newcomer Acula must be taken seriously, with Emiza another debutant to monitor in the market

  1. NAUTIC STAR (IRE)
  2. NEVER THE SAME (IRE)
  3. ACULA (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Expensive purchase THE MEAN FIDDLER may make amends for his near miss on debut. War Gaming looks a serious danger.

  1. THE MEAN FIDDLER (IRE)
  2. WAR GAMING (IRE)
  3. REFLECT ON GLORY (IRE)

races.name: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This looks a good opportunity for QUEEN SANA to belatedly open her account. Karl Burke's Royale Union could be the one to follow her home.

  1. QUEEN SANA
  2. ROYALE UNION (IRE)
  3. SECRET HARVEST

races.name: Weatherbys Bloodstock Pro Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
There's plenty to like about ZOUSTAR DREAMS and Angel Numbers and they stand out in this handicap, with preference just given to Ed Dunlop's progressive 3-y-o.

  1. ZOUSTAR DREAMS
  2. ANGEL NUMBERS (IRE)
  3. MARAJITO

races.name: Wilmot-Smith Memorial Handicap
races.verdict:
DARK CLOUD RISING remains well treated on the pick of his form and can be given another chance to build on his June C&D success. The in-form Lord Roxby can go well again, while Rousing Encore can complete the 1-2-3.

  1. DARK CLOUD RISING
  2. LORD ROXBY (IRE)
  3. ROUSING ENCORE (IRE)

races.name: North Yorkshire Ice Cream Championship 2026 Handicap
races.verdict:
A tricky little handicap to solve but the vote goes to POLYGRAM to quickly double her tally. The danger could be Poet's Dawn, a 3-time C&D winner seeking a hat-trick.

  1. POLYGRAM
  2. POET'S DAWN
  3. EVERYONEKNOWSADAVE (IRE)

races.name: Queen Ethelburga's Collegiate Handicap
races.verdict:
AMBER HAMUR has made a good start for her new yard and could win again in what looks a thin race. The well-handicapped Dacres Cross, along with Sailor's Return, are feared most.

  1. AMBER HAMUR (IRE)
  2. DACRES CROSS (IRE)
  3. SAILOR'S RETURN

races.name: Weatherbys Digital Solutions Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Unexposed AURA CHAMPAGNE is narrowly preferred to recent C&D runner-up Moonlit Surf.

  1. AURA CHAMPAGNE (IRE)
  2. MOONLIT SURF
  3. YIMMNA (FR)

races.name: Weatherbys Global Stallions App EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes  (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BLUE SIGN may be able to get off the mark with sights lowered. Newcomers Piper Cee and Lady Leora look interesting, especially if supported.

  1. BLUE SIGN
  2. PIPER CEE (IRE)
  3. LADY LEORA (FR)

races.name: Weatherbys VAT Services Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
MOBADIR should be better for a gelding operation, and he can make a winning start in nurseries. Star People and Leucothea appeal most of the remainder.

  1. MOBADIR (IRE)
  2. STAR PEOPLE (FR)
  3. LEUCOTHEA (IRE)

races.name: weatherbysshop.co.uk Handicap
races.verdict:
A trappy sprint in which it could pay to side with STAR MARIAN, who has been disappointing in handicaps since making a winning return in a Wolverhampton maiden but takes a drop in class here with first-time blinkers applied. Reunited with Rossa Ryan, she can get the better of Invincible Crown, who wasn't disgraced at Catterick recently and quickly drops back in grade. Up The Monk can fill out third.

  1. STAR MARIAN
  2. INVINCIBLE CROWN (IRE)
  3. UP THE MONK

races.name: Weatherbys BetTrends Handicap
races.verdict:
DEL CORSO merely had to match his previous form to get off the mark over C&D recently and with better still to come over this trip, Ed Walker's 3-y-o gets the nod to follow up. Dawn of Liberation has been edging back to form this season and returning from a 10-week break, he gets the vote for the forecast spot.

  1. DEL CORSO
  2. DAWN OF LIBERATION (IRE)
  3. SEDEIRAH (IRE)

races.name: Weatherbys Racing Bank Handicap
races.verdict:
VENETIAN LION proved a different proposition sent handicapping when finishing runner-up at Southwell last week and with further progress on the cards, William Haggas' 3-y-o is expected to take some stopping if translating that form back to turf. Theme Park and Straight A look the pair most likely to chase him home.

  1. VENETIAN LION
  2. THEME PARK
  3. STRAIGHT A

races.name: A1R Services Ltd Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
GREEN TEAM scored on his third start for this yard when making most at Wolverhampton in May and he is taken to follow up from what remains a handy mark. I'd Go Maniac arrives in good heart and could be the main danger, while Shahbaz is interesting with a recent run behind him.

  1. GREEN TEAM (FR)
  2. I'D GO MANIAC (FR)
  3. SHAHBAZ (IRE)

races.name: Wasdell Group Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Preference is for LOVELY DARK ANGEL, who makes plenty of appeal on paper for a yard which has had a couple of winning 2-y-o newcomers recently. Rocsane has been going the right way and is feared most, ahead of the once-raced Decem Carolinae.

  1. LOVELY DARK ANGEL (IRE)
  2. ROCSANE (IRE)
  3. DECEM CAROLINAE

races.name: Wasdell Group EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A repeat of the form NIGHT SHINING showed in handicap company at Kempton last time might be good enough here. Ardnamurchan is open to improvement on the back of her Leicester debut and may give George Boughey's charge most to do ahead of Pilgrim's Progress.

  1. NIGHT SHINING (IRE)
  2. ARDNAMURCHAN
  3. PILGRIM'S PROGRESS

races.name: Happy Birthday Tyne Patterson Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
A trappy affair which may go the way of SAUCY JANE if she can get away on terms this time. Q T Pie could pose a threat if first-time cheekpieces help her to recapture the form she showed when second on her Goodwood reappearance. The presence of Oisin Murphy in the saddle makes Havana Halo one to keep an eye on in the betting.

  1. SAUCY JANE
  2. Q T PIE
  3. HAVANA HALO

races.name: Talk Sport Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
LETSBEATSEPSIS has had a few chances now but 3 of his 4 efforts this year have been creditable and he's taken to land a breakthrough success at the expense of Tiger Beetle and Saturday's Lingfield winner Panthere Noir.

  1. LETSBEATSEPSIS
  2. TIGER BEETLE
  3. PANTHERE NOIR

races.name: Talk Sport Radio Handicap
races.verdict:
CHILLY BREEZE bounced back to form when second at Doncaster recently and is taken to go one better with Billy Loughnane taking the reins now. Adrian Wintle has his team in good nick at present and his recent Bath scorer Havana Club may provide the main threat ahead of Havana Tobouggaloo.

  1. CHILLY BREEZE
  2. HAVANA CLUB
  3. HAVANA TOBOUGGALOO

races.name: www.mourneabbeyoil.ie Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
EMERALD ENIGMA looked good when landing a couple of bumpers in the spring and will be tough to beat if she can translate that level of ability to hurdles. Belladaball was also fairly useful in the bumper field and can build on her Kilbeggan hurdle debut fourth and provide the main threat ahead of the selection's stablemate Easter Bonnet.

  1. EMERALD ENIGMA (IRE)
  2. BELLADABALL (IRE)
  3. EASTER BONNET (FR)

races.name: John O'Flynn Motors 110 Series Final Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
METAMORPHEUS looks the one to be with if turned out quickly. Gino Bella is readily preferred as the next best, with Dairy Force and Let's Go La Fichad also considered.

  1. METAMORPHEUS (IRE)
  2. GINO BELLA (IRE)
  3. DAIRY FORCE (IRE)

races.name: Follow Us On Instagram Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
INA MINA hasn’t shown much over hurdles so far, but she is well treated on last summer’s Flat form and looks worth chancing in an ordinary handicap. Syosset arrives in good order and looks the chief threat, with Stily and Highland Earl also respected.

  1. INA MINA
  2. SYOSSET (IRE)
  3. STILY (FR)

races.name: Follow Us On Instagram Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
UPTAURINTOP has been threatening to come good over hurdles for some time and looks worth siding with to finally put it all together. Toon Town is well treated on his latest chasing success and rates the chief danger, with both Chesterbaylad and Inchiquin Maid respected.

  1. UPTAURINTOP (IRE)
  2. TOON TOWN (IRE)
  3. CHESTERBAYLAD (IRE)

races.name: Adare Manor Opportunity Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
LIVIO should prove too strong if back on song. Eye Contact appeals as the main danger, with Saporetti, Johnny Rambo and Master Sydney considered for the places.

  1. LIVIO (FR)
  2. EYE CONTACT
  3. SAPORETTI (IRE)

races.name: Jim Ryan Racecourse Services Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
O'GRADY CRACKER looked much improved when powering 12 lengths clear at Kilbeggan 10 days ago and is taken to defy a 10 lb rise. Inthenickoftime is on a handy mark and should be spot on after his return, so rates the main danger, with Calzaghi and Crowsatedappletart also capable of being involved.

  1. O'GRADY CRACKER (IRE)
  2. INTHENICKOFTIME (IRE)
  3. CALZAGHI (IRE)

races.name: Curragh To Curragh Charity Cycle On Saturday August 29th Flat Race
races.verdict:
GREEN STYLE gets the nod to make light of a long absence on his first run for Willie Mullins, with confidence in his chance increased should the betting vibes be strong. Echoes of Jane and Tale of Intrigue have been knocking on the door in similar contests and look the main dangers unless the betting speaks in favour of one of the newcomers.

  1. GREEN STYLE (IRE)
  2. ECHOES OF JANE (IRE)
  3. TALE OF INTRIGUE (IRE)
